hook: Private industry nonfatal workplace injuries and illnesses hit their lowest level since 2003 this year.

sections.voiceover: Private industry nonfatal workplace injuries and illnesses hit their lowest level since 2003 this year.
Did total illness cases fall by 26.1 percent for private industry workers in the United States?
However, respiratory illness cases plummeted by 67.6 percent, marking the third consecutive year of decline.
Total illness cases reported by private employers fell by 26.1 percent throughout 2025. The Bureau of Labor Statistics reports 2.4 million total nonfatal workplace cases across the United States.
This 2025 data represents the lowest recorded level since the reporting series began in 2003.
